test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 2 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is NOT an example of an e-mail service provider?

I. Outlook

II. Gmail

III. Yandex
solution:
**The correct option is 3) All are e-mail service providers**:

__
 
• This option 3 is correct as all three options are examples of e-mail service providers.
 
• Outlook is Microsoft's e-mail service provider, Gmail is Google's e-mail service provider, and Yandex is a Russian-based e-mail service provider.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This option 1 is incorrect as both Outlook and Yandex are examples of e-mail service providers. Outlook is Microsoft's e-mail service provider, while Yandex is a Russian-based e-mail service provider.

 This option 2 is incorrect as Yandex is also an e-mail service provider. Yandex is a popular e-mail service provider in Russia that offers free e-mail accounts.
 
• This option 4 is incorrect as Outlook is an example of an e-mail service provider. Outlook is Microsoft's e-mail service provider that is part of the Microsoft Office suite of applications.
 
• In summary, the correct answer is option 3 - all of the given options are examples of e-mail service providers.
